verdict.rationale: Granola explicitly claims cross-platform meeting support ("Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and every other meeting app") and offers a bot-free, local-audio capture model ("Uses your computer audio, so doesn't invite a bot"), directly addressing the 'recording where I want it' preference, backed by calendar integration and in-meeting transparency notices. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of capture reliability specifically across Zoom/Meet/Teams, and no evidence of alternative recording modes (e.g., bot-based option) for users who might want that instead.
